policy: Historical methods are implementation opportunities, not validation evidence.
Only verified CrystalProbe records can support headline benchmark claims.
Optional scientific backends should record missing-backend states instead of hiding them.

opportunities.older_source: Dunitz/Gavezzotti crystal predictability debate and CCDC blind-test lineage
opportunities.old_blocker: Expensive search, uneven evidence records, and hard-to-rebuild comparisons
opportunities.modern_enabler: MLIP inference, public artifact checks, structured evidence tiers, and CI

opportunities.old_blocker: Manual motif interpretation and limited automated feature extraction
opportunities.modern_enabler: CIF parsers, curated functional-group tags, and deterministic report figures

opportunities.older_source: Metropolis Monte Carlo, simulated annealing, basin-hopping, and replica exchange
opportunities.old_blocker: Many local minima, expensive relaxations, and weak provenance for search paths
opportunities.modern_enabler: GPU-backed MLIPs, cheap ensemble screening, and structured ledgers

opportunities.older_source: Zwanzig FEP, Bennett acceptance ratio, umbrella sampling, metadynamics, and REMD
opportunities.old_blocker: Slow sampling and limited convergence diagnostics for routine use
opportunities.modern_enabler: MLIP trajectories, parallel execution, bootstrap diagnostics, and abstention policies

opportunities.historical_thread: Active learning and expensive black-box optimization
opportunities.older_source: Query by committee and Efficient Global Optimization
opportunities.old_blocker: Manual experiment selection and costly model evaluations
opportunities.modern_enabler: Backend disagreement, source-acquisition ledgers, and cheap queue scoring

opportunities.historical_thread: Bootstrap, conformal prediction, and calibrated abstention
opportunities.older_source: Efron's bootstrap and Vovk/Gammerman/Shafer conformal prediction
opportunities.old_blocker: Sparse calibration data and limited routine resampling
opportunities.modern_enabler: Stored predictions, repeated runs, verified slices, and deterministic reports

opportunities.old_blocker: Provenance and licensing were often separated from downstream computation
opportunities.modern_enabler: Record-level schemas, release-boundary checks, and docs-as-tests

opportunities.old_blocker: Fragile local environments and unrebuildable figures
opportunities.modern_enabler: Git, CI, JSON manifests, deterministic SVGs, and executable demos

opportunities.older_source: Behler-Parrinello neural network potentials and GAP
opportunities.old_blocker: Quantum-level energy surfaces were too expensive for broad search and sampling
opportunities.modern_enabler: MACE, AIMNet2, UMA, fairchem, and optional backend adapters
